notes: Parkour at the player's own pace up a tower is Obby & Platformer on course-tower, which carries the genre-wide P6 and the P2 that comes with platforms sitting directly above each other. Took the Tower Obby preset and added obstacle-jump and obstacle-moving so the ten stages can each be a distinct section rather than repeats of one obstacle type. With no user to ask I assumed a checkpoint per stage, since ten numbered stages is how Roblox players describe per-stage restarts on a small tower, and read the top as the winner-zone payoff given the answers rule out a timer or leaderboard. The clean stylized block look is image theming and adds no layout options; nothing here needs a maze, a shop hub, or lethal surfaces.
